## Install
For handling python environments and installing packages in general, we recommend using:

- [pixi](https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/)

Delft-FIAT be contained from either:

- [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/delft-fiat/)
- [conda-forge](https://anaconda.org/channels/conda-forge/packages/delft_fiat/overview)

With pixi one can install the library from pypi using:

```bash
pixi run pip install delft-fiat
```

or from conda-forge using:

```bash
pixi add delft_fiat
```

Other methods of using/ working with Delft-FIAT include:

- [Builing as an executable](build.qmd)
- [Execution via a container](image.qmd)
- [Development install](dev.qmd)
